title: The woman behind the voice of Siri – B1 English Listening Test

seo.title: The woman behind the voice of Siri – B1 English Listening Test - Test-English
seo.description: Listening comprehension test for intermediate students (CEFR B1). Watch a video about technology and choose the correct answers.

parts:
B1 English Listening Test

Watch a video about Susan Bennett, the woman behind Siri, and for questions 1 to 7, choose the correct answer.

For more videos like this, go to People in America VOA
Questions

questions.prompt: Susan got her first job as a voice actress...
After that first job as a voice actress...

choices.html: she has always worked as a voice actress.
she has worked as a voice coach.
the voice that Susan recorded for a bank.

questions.prompt: Susan found out that she was Siri...
How did Susan feel when she learned that she was Siri?

choices.html: it's cool to be on people's phones.
being Siri has damaged her professional career.
it wasn't easy to accept that she was Siri.
Siri has been more negative than positive.
her role as Siri has made her lose many jobs.
she gets a lot of work thanks to Siri.
